title: RAW UNREVIEWED: same olives yield first and later pressing oils
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Find a dated primary olive-processing passage, with Cato De Agri Cultura or Palladius as leads, that explicitly owns one olive batch and distinguishes oil from an initial pressing from oil after a later treatment. A target requires an admitted preparation sequence with independently owned batch, ordered operations and output loci. An olive-looking plant alone cannot supply a word anchor. Verify that the primary actually states a directional quality or use difference before freezing a test.
